text: Dark: Deploy on your sandcrawler. Each Jawa is forfeit +2 here. 'Nighttime conditions' here. Light: Your characters may enter/exit here for 1 Force each. 'Nighttime conditions' here.

name: R5-D4 (Arfive-Defour)
text: While aboard any starship, adds 1 to power and maneuver. During your control phase, if aboard your starship damaged by an ion cannon, restores armor/maneuver and hyperspeed.

name: Tatooine: Bluffs
text: Dark: 'Bluff Rules' in effect here. Light: 'Bluff Rules' in effect here.

name: Black 4
text: May add 1 pilot. May deploy with a pilot as a 'react' to a battle where you have a TIE (for free if TIE is Black 2 or 3).

name: Conquest
text: May add 6 pilots, 8 passengers, 2 vehicles and 4 TIEs. Has ship-docking capability. Permanent pilot provides ability of 1. Just after initiating battle against Falcon, may peek at opponent's hand.

name: TIE Assault Squadron
text: * Replaces 3 TIE/lns at one location (TIE/lns go to Used Pile). Permanent pilots provide total ability of 3.

name: TIE Vanguard
text: Permanent pilot provides ability of 1. You may deploy cards to same system or sector as a 'react'.

name: Victory-Class Star Destroyer
text: May add 4 pilots, 6 passengers, 1 vehicle and 3 TIEs. Has ship-docking capability. Permanent pilot provides ability of 1. Adds 1 to your total power in battles at related planet sites.

name: Bespin Motors Void Spider THX 1138
text: May add 3 passengers. Permanent pilot provides ability of 1. May move as a 'react.' *Landspeed = 3. OR Up to 3 characters may shuttle to or from same site for free.

name: Mobquet A-1 Deluxe Floater
text: May add 1 driver and 1 passenger. Moves free if Jabba or any bounty hunter aboard. May move for free as a 'react' to a battle where your thief, smuggler or bounty hunter is participating.

name: Enhanced TIE Laser Cannon
text: Use 1 Force to deploy on your TIE. May target a starship using 1 Force. Draw destiny. Subtract 2 if targeting a capital starship. Target hit if total destiny > defense value.

name: Jawa Blaster
text: Deploy on your Jawa. May target a character or creature for free. Draw destiny. If destiny -1 > defense value, target hit. If destiny = 0, Jawa Blaster 'explodes' (weapon and character firing it are lost).

name: RA-7 (Aray-Seven)
text: May transfer character weapons (for free) to or from your other characters present. May carry up to four such weapons at one time.

name: Leia Seeker
text: Deploys for 1 Force to an unoccupied site. Deploys and moves like an undercover spy. When present with Leia (or warrior) of ability < 3, choose one to be immediately lost (treat as an 'all cards' situation). Seeker is also lost.

name: Superlaser
text: Deploy on Death Star system at parsec 0. May target a capital starship at Death Star system, or at a system it orbits, using 4 Force. Draw two destiny. Target hit if total destiny > defense value.

name: URoRRuR'R'R's Hunting Rifle
text: Use 1 Force to deploy on URoRRuR'R'R or Chief Bast, 3 on your non-droid character. May target a character or creature using 1 Force. Draw destiny. Subtract 1 if targeting a character. Add 2 if targeting a creature. Target hit if total destiny > defense value.

name: Rebel Commander
text: Adds 1 to forfeit of each of your other Rebels (except leaders) at same site. Bothan spies deploy free to same location.

name: Rebel Squad Leader
text: Adds 1 to forfeit of your other troopers and Rebel Guards at same site. When moving with a 'squad' of exactly three other troopers and/or Rebel Guards, all four move for 1 Force. Rebel Guards at same site may move.

name: Rebel Tech
text: When at your war room: Cumulatively adds 1 to total of Attack Run. OR Once during each of your control phases, may send this tech to your Used Pile and take Death Star: Trench into hand from Reserve Deck; reshuffle.

name: Brainiac
text: * Power = v(3(X-Y)+2(A-B)+ p) (minimum power = 1). X = Dark Side hand cards; Y = Light Side hand cards; A = total number of Dark icons in play; B = total number of Light icons in play; π = 3.141592653589793238462643383...

name: Saurin
text: At any time, may use 1 Force to remove (lose) a Restraining Bolt at same site. Receives an extra power +1 when 'protected' by Sai'torr Kal Fas.

name: Tiree
text: Adds 2 to power of anything he pilots. When piloting Gold 2, also adds 1 to maneuver and (when in Death Star: Trench) adds 1 to total of Attack Run.

name: Tzizvvt
text: May 'fly' (move) only during your deploy phase, up to two sites away, for 1 Force. Power +1 at Trash Compactor, any Dagobah site or same site as Dark Waters or Tarkin.

name: Wedge Antilles
text: Adds 3 to power of anything he pilots. When piloting Red 2, also adds 2 to maneuver and draws one battle destiny if not able to otherwise. May use 1 Force to take one Corellian Slip into hand from Reserve Deck; reshuffle.

name: Zutton
text: Where present, just before opponent draws battle destiny, you may use 1 Force to reduce opponent's total battle destiny by 1.

name: Fire Extinguisher
text: Deploy on your astromech droid. Cancels an 'exploding' Program Trap here. Any starship it is aboard is immune to Lateral Damage and ion cannons. If deployed on R2-D2, may lose Fire Extinguisher to cancel a battle just initiated where present at a site.

name: Magnetic Suction Tube
text: Deploy on your sandcrawler. Once during each of your control phases, may target one character present. Draw destiny. If destiny > character's ability, 'suck up' character (relocate to related interior Sandcrawler site or owner's Used Pile).

name: Rectenna
text: Use 1 Force to deploy on your starship. You may deploy cards as a 'react' to a battle at same system or sector.

name: Remote
text: Use 1 Force to deploy at any site. Moves like a character at normal use of the Force. Once during each of your control phases, may: Select one character present to be power or forfeit +1 for remainder of turn. OR Use 2 Force to cancel any seeker present.

name: Sensor Panel
text: Use 1 Force to deploy on your non-creature vehicle. Adds 1 to power and landspeed. Once per turn, when you play Radar Scanner, you may use 1 Force to move one additional Effect or Interrupt card found in opponent's hand to Used Pile.

name: Chewbacca
text: Power +1 at same location as Han. Adds 2 to power of anything he pilots. When piloting Falcon, also adds 1 to maneuver. Your vehicles, starships, and droids at same site that are 'hit' and about to be lost go to Used Pile instead.

name: Cell 2187
text: Deploy on any Death Star site except Docking Bay 327. Target your spy or leader not on Death Star. When target reaches Utinni Effect, draw destiny. Release that many captives from the Detention Block Corridor. Lose Utinni Effect.

name: Commence Recharging
text: Deploy on a superlaser. May not fire at a planet unless 8 cards stacked here. If fewer than 8 cards stacked here, opponent may stack top card of Force Pile here. If just fired at a system, Effect is canceled. If Effect canceled, cards stacked here are placed in Used Pile.

name: Eject! Eject!
text: Use 1 Force to target a starfighter having one or more permanent pilots. Draw destiny. If destiny > 2, deploy on starfighter to remove all permanent pilots (otherwise, Effect is lost). May add 1 pilot for each permanent pilot removed. (Immune to Alter.)

name: Grappling Hook
text: If opponent just played an Interrupt, use 1 Force to deploy on table and stack that Interrupt here. All Interrupts of that title are unique (•). (Immune to Control.)

name: Logistical Delay
text: Use 3 Force to deploy on opponent's side of table. All opponent's TIEs are deploy +1.

name: Luke's Cape
text: Use 2 Force to deploy on a Rebel or alien. If Luke's Cape is not at a Tatooine location, your total Force generation is +1. That character is immune to attrition < 3.

name: Merc Sunlet
text: Deploy on your non-thief to give that character thief skill. Once during each of your control phases, may target one device at same site. Draw destiny. If destiny < target's destiny number, it is stolen. OR Deploy on a weapon to prevent theft. (Immune to Alter.)

name: Scanner Techs
text: Deploy on your side of table. Radar Scanner is immune to Sense. If Radar Scanner is played against an opponent who has more than 13 cards in hand, opponent loses all Jawas, Tusken Raiders and stormtroopers found there.

name: Solomahal
text: Deploy on your warrior to give that warrior scout skill. That warrior may move as a 'react.' OR Deploy on your scout. When that scout 'reacts,' it is power +2 for remainder of turn. (Immune to Alter.)

name: They're On Dantooine
text: Once per game, use 2 Force to deploy on Dantooine system. Target Death Star. Opponent may not play Commence Primary Ignition until target reaches Dantooine, canceling Utinni Effect.

name: Commander Evram Lajaie
text: When at a Yavin 4, Hoth or Endor site, Rebel starships may move to the related system as a 'react'.

name: Undercover
text: Deploy on your spy at a site and cross spy to opponent's side. Spy is now Undercover. During your deploy phase, may voluntarily 'break cover' (lose Effect) if at a site. (Immune to Alter.)

name: What're You Tryin' To Push On Us?
text: Use 3 Force to deploy on table and stack one just-played interrupt here. To play any new Interrupt of the same name, player must first stack it here and use +1 Force for each Interrupt in stack, even if Interrupt is normally free. (Immune to Control.)

name: Attack Run
text: Deploy on Death Star: Trench. During your move phase, you may make an Attack Run as follows: Enter Trench: Move up to 3 of your starfighters into trench (for free). Dark Side may immediately follow with up to 3 TIEs (for free). Provide Cover: Identify your lead starfighter (Proton Torpedoes* required) and wingmen (if any). Turbolaser Batteries and TIEs with weapons may now target your starfighters (wingmen first, then lead if no wingmen remaining). Hit starfighters are immediately lost. It's Away!: Draw two destiny. Pull Up!: All starfighters now move to Death Star system (for free). If (total destiny + X + Y - Z) > 15, Death Star is 'blown away.' X = ability of lead pilot (or 3 if Targeting Computer aboard) just before Pull Up!. Y = total sites at largest Rebel Base (Yavin 4 or Hoth). Z = highest ability of opponent's TIE pilots in trench just before Pull Up!. *Your Proton Torpedoes are immune to Overload.

name: Advance Preparation
text: USED: Place out of play any one of the following from your hand: Attack Run, You're All Clear Kid, Death Star: Trench or Rebel Tech. Retrieve 1 Force. LOST: Use 3 Force to retrieve Attack Run.

name: Alternatives To Fighting
text: Use 3 Force to cancel a battle just initiated at a system or sector. OR Cancel Besieged. OR Release (move for free) all your characters from a captured starship to your side of any docking bay site.

name: Blast The Door, Kid!
text: If a battle was just initiated at an interior site, use 1 Force; for remainder of battle, all characters of ability > 2 and all leaders (on both sides) are simultaneously excluded from that battle.

name: Blue Milk
text: USED: Select a player to activate 1 Force. LOST: Cancel Juri Juice or Hypo.

name: Corellian Slip
text: If opponent just initiated a Tallon Roll, add your maneuver + ability of one pilot on you targeted starfighter to your total. OR Decrease the maneuver of an opponent's starfighter by 1 for remainder of this turn.

name: Double Agent
text: If both players have a spy at same site, draw destiny. Add 2 if opponent's spy is Undercover. Opponent's spy is lost if total destiny > 2. OR Opponent's Tonnika Sisters present at a site cross to your side.

name: Grimtaash
text: USED: If opponent has 13 or more cards in hand, place all but 8 (random selection) in Used Pile. LOST: Cancel Molator (even at a holosite). OR Use 4 Force to reveal opponent's hand. All cards opponent has two or more of in hand are lost.

name: Commander Vanden Willard
text: When at a war room you control, adds 1 to power of each Rebel starship at the related system. May use 1 Force to cancel Astromech Shortage.

name: Houjix
text: During the damage segment of a battle you lost, if you have no cards left that can be forfeited, cancel all remaining battle damage. (Immune to Sense.) OR Cancel Sunsdown.

name: I Have A Very Bad Feeling About This
text: If opponent just deployed four or more characters to same location this turn, prevent all of those characters from battling this turn. OR If opponent just 'reacted' to a battle, cancel the battle.

name: I'm Here To Rescue You
text: If you have a spy present at the Detention Block Corridor, target a captive there. Draw destiny. If destiny + ability of spy > ability of captive, target is released. Otherwise, spy is captured. OR Cancel Spice Mines Of Kessel (releasing targeted captive).

name: Let The Wookiee Win
text: During a battle at a holosite, add one battle destiny. OR Target an opponent's character of ability < 5 present with your Wookiee that just participated in a battle you lost; character is Disarmed (power -1 and may no longer carry weapons). Stack on that character.

name: Out Of Commission
text: During your control phase, use 2 Force to release a starship held by any Tractor Beam. (Not effective on Death Star Tractor Beam if Central Core in play.) OR Randomly select one card from opponent's Lost Pile or Blaster Rack and place out of play.

name: Quite A Mercenary
text: If Elis Helrot just completed a transport, use 2 Force. Elis and all character transported are lost. (Immune to Sense.) OR Prevent a just deployed smuggler from moving this turn.

name: Sabotage
text: During your control phase, target one weapon, device or vehicle at same site as your Undercover spy. Draw destiny. If destiny > target's deploy cost, target is lost (may be stolen instead if spy also a thief). OR Cancel Informant.

name: Sorry About The Mess
text: During your control phase, fire one of your weapons. If Han firing, may add 1 to each weapon destiny draw. (A seeker may be targeted by a character weapon, as if a character with defense value of 4.) Any 'hit' targets are immediately lost.

name: Wookiee Roar
text: If Chewie is defending a battle alone at a site, add two battle destiny. OR Use 3 Force to take Chewie into hand from Reserve Deck; reshuffle. OR Scare off (lose) one 'mouse' droid on table.

name: You're All Clear Kid!
text: Cancel I'm On The Leader. (Immune to Sense.) OR Use 1 Force during an Attack Run. Move one TIE in Death Star: Trench (your choice) to Death Star system for free. Add 1 to total of Attack Run if lead starfighter has matching pilot aboard.

name: Corellian
text: Once per turn, one weapon or device is deploy -1 onto a Rebel at same site.

name: Clak'dor VII
text: Light: If you occupy, each Bith character is destiny +2. Dark: If you control, each Bith character is destiny -1 and Ghhhk is power +2 in battles at a holosite.

name: Corellia
text: Light: Your Falcon and your Corellian corvettes may deploy here as a 'react.' Dark: Your starships are hyperspeed +1 when moving from here.

name: Death Star: Trench
text: Light: 'Trench Rules' in effect and each of your starfighters is maneuver - 2 here. Dark: 'Trench Rules' in effect, your weapons fire free and Turbolaser Battery may deploy here.

name: Dejarik Hologameboard
text: Light: 'Dejarik Rules' in effect here. Dark: 'Dejarik Rules' in effect here. Site converted by Imperial Holotable.

name: Kashyyyk
text: Light: Your Wookiees and smugglers deploy -2 here. Dark: Total ability of 6 or more required for you to draw battle destiny here.

name: Ralltiir
text: Light: Your starships may move here as a 'react.' Dark: Your capital starships deploy -2 here.

name: Sandcrawler: Loading Bay
text: Light: Deploy on your sandcrawler. Each Jawa is forfeit +2 here. 'Nighttime conditions' here. Dark: Your characters may enter/exit here for 1 Force each. 'Nighttime conditions' here.

name: Yavin 4: Briefing Room
text: Light: If you control, with a leader here, may add 1 to total of Attack Run. Dark: If you control, Force drain +1 here and subtract 1 from total of Attack Run.

name: Yavin 4: Massassi Ruins
text: Light: If you control, with a leader here, your starships are each power +1 at Death Star system. Dark: If you control, Force drain +1 here.

name: Gold 2
text: May add 2 pilots or passengers. May forfeit in place of your other starfighter hit in Death Star: Trench, restoring that starfighter to normal.

name: Doikk Na'ts
text: For each other musician at same site, the ability required to draw battle destiny here increases by 1 for both players.

name: Red 2
text: May add 1 pilot and 1 astromech. Immune to attrition < 3 if Wedge piloting.

name: Red 5
text: May add 1 pilot and 1 astromech. Immune to attrition < 4 if Luke piloting. When firing in an Attack Run, adds 1 to total.

name: Red 6
text: May add 1 pilot. Opponent may add 2 to destiny drawn for I've Got A Problem Here when targeting Red 6.

name: Tantive IV
text: May be deployed even without presence or Force icons. May add 3 pilots and 4 passengers. Has ship-docking capability. Permanent pilot provides ability of 2.

name: Y-wing Assault Squadron
text: * Replaces 3 Y-wings at one location (Y-wings go to Used Pile). May add 3 pilots or passengers. Permanent pilots provide total ability of 3.

name: Incom T-16 Skyhopper
text: May add 1 passenger. Permanent pilot provides ability of 1. May move as a 'react.' * Landspeed = 4. OR 1 character may shuttle to or from same site for free.

name: Rogue Bantha
text: May add 2 'riders' (passengers). Bantha ability = ½. May move as a 'react.' Whenever a battle was just initiated at same site, one Tusken Raider present (your choice) is 'trampled' (immediately lost).

name: Bowcaster
text: Use X Force to deploy on your warrior, where X = (7 - warrior's power). X cannot fall below 1. May target a character or creature using X Force. Draw destiny. Add 1 if targeting a character, 2 if targeting a creature. Target hit if total destiny > defense value.

name: Jawa Ion Gun
text: Use 1 Force to deploy on your Jawa, 3 on your warrior. May target a character using 1 Force. Draw destiny. Targeted droid stolen if destiny +1 > forfeit. Targeted non-droid character excluded from battle if destiny = defense value.

name: Luke's Hunting Rifle
text: Use 1 Force to deploy on Luke or Owen Lars, 3 on your non-droid character. May target a character or creature using 1 Force. Draw destiny. Subtract 1 if targeting a character. Add 2 if targeting a creature. Target hit if total destiny > defense value.

name: Garouf Lafoe
text: Adds 1 to power of anything he pilots. Adds 1 to forfeit of each of your characters at same Tatooine site. Subtracts 1 from forfeit of each of opponent's characters at same Hoth site. Game text suspended if at same site as a tax collector.

name: Motti Seeker
text: Deploys for 1 Force to an unoccupied site. Deploys and moves like an undercover spy. When present with Motti (or pilot) of ability < 3, choose one to be immediately lost (treat as an 'all cards' situation). Seeker also lost.

name: SW-4 Ion Cannon
text: Use 1 Force to deploy on your Y-wing or B-wing. May target a starship using 1 Force. Draw destiny. If destiny > target's defense value, all starship weapons deployed on target are lost, armor or maneuver = 0 and hyperspeed = 0.

name: Advosze
text: Adds 2 to power of anything he pilots. Whenever you deploy a weapon or device from hand at same location, activate 1 Force as a 'kickback.' Limit of one Advosze per location.

name: Captain Khurgee
text: Once during each of your control phases, you may use 2 Force to take one Scanning Crew into hand from Reserve Deck; reshuffle.

name: Dannik Jerriko
text: Once per battle, may use 1 Force to 'eat the soup' of (place out of play) one opposing non-droid character just lost or forfeited at same site. * Power = 1 + total ability of all victims whose soup was eaten.

name: Danz Borin
text: Adds 3 to power of anything he pilots. Adds 1 to weapon destiny draws of anything he is aboard as a passenger.

name: Death Star Gunner
text: If on Death Star: Cumulatively adds 2 to total of Commence Primary Ignition. OR During your control phase, may send this gunner to your Used Pile and take Superlaser into hand from Reserve Deck; reshuffle.

name: Defel
text: Under 'nighttime conditions,' may use 1 Force to 'hide' (exclude himself) from a battle. While at a site affected by Revolution, opponent must lose 1 Force during your control phase.

name: DS-61-4
text: Adds 3 to power of anything he pilots. When piloting Black 4, also may draw one battle destiny if not able to otherwise. May use 1 Force to take one Lone Pilot into hand from Reserve Deck; reshuffle.

name: Greedo
text: During opponent's control phase, may 'threaten' one smuggler at same site. Opponent may use all Force Pile cards to cancel threat, allowing you to activate same amount. Otherwise, draw destiny. If destiny + Greedo's ability > 6, smuggler lost.

name: Het Nkik
text: * Deploys only on Tatooine for 2 Force from each player's Force Pile. Het is power +1 for each Stormtrooper at same site, unless Reegesk is present.

name: Hem Dazon
text: Once during each of your deploy phases, may place, face down, one card from hand or Force Pile under Hem, as 'salt consumption.' If Hem lost, cards underneath also lost. *Power = 1 + number of cards underneath.

name: Imperial Commander
text: Adds 1 to forfeit of each of your other Imperials (except leaders) at same site.

name: Imperial Squad Leader
text: Adds 1 to forfeit of your other troopers at same site. When moving with a 'squad' of exactly three other troopers, all four move for 1 Force. Imperial Trooper Guards at same site may move.

name: IT-O (Eyetee-Oh)
text: When at Detention Block Corridor, adds X to your Force drains there, where X = the number of captives present. Immune to Restraining Bolt.

name: Lirin Car'n
text: For each other musician present, adds a 'cover charge' of 1 to the Force required to move or deploy each character to same site.

name: Lt. Pol Treidum
text: While at Docking Control Room 327, adds 2 to your total power at Docking Bay 327. Once during each of your control phases, if at same site as an Undercover spy, may draw destiny. Spy's 'cover is broken' if destiny = spy's ability.

name: Lt. Shann Childsen
text: Power +2 when at Detention Block Corridor or Detention Block Control Room. Also, power +2 when an opponent's alien is present (+3 if alien is a Wookiee, Talz or Ewok).

name: Mosep
text: When opponent is losing Force from Force drains at the same or an adjacent site, lost Force must come from Reserve Deck if possible.

name: Officer Evax
text: Adds 2 to power of anything he pilots. When at a Death Star site, Imperial starships may move to the Death Star system as a 'react.'

name: R2-Q2 (Artoo-Kyootoo)
text: While aboard any starfighter, adds 1 to power, maneuver and hyperspeed. When at a Scomp link during your draw phase, may use 1 Force to peek at top three cards of your Reserve Deck.
